"""Run main.py in a restricted child (seccomp + rlimits) with a large payload."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace')
from limits import restrict_child

payload_path = sys.argv[1]
data = open(payload_path, 'rb').read()
env = {'PATH': '/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin', 'HOME': '/workspace', 'LANG': 'C', 'LC_ALL': 'C',
       'TMPDIR': '/workspace/tmp/scratch', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE': '1', 'PYTHONUNBUFFERED': '1',
       'PYTHONHASHSEED': '0', 'OMP_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS': '1',
       'MKL_NUM_THREADS': '1', 'PYTHONPATH': '/opt/deps'}
os.makedirs('/workspace/tmp/scratch', exist_ok=True)
t0 = time.time()
child = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-B', '-u', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                         stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                         cwd='/workspace/tmp/scratch', env=env, close_fds=True,
                         preexec_fn=restrict_child)
out, err = child.communicate(data, timeout=170)
wall = time.time() - t0
print('rc', child.returncode, 'wall %.2f' % wall, 'out', len(out), 'err', err[:500])
if child.returncode == 0:
    doc = json.loads(out.decode())
    print('streams', len(doc.get('streams', [])))
PYEOF
